designRules: 45 new independent weapon acquisitions: 40 Gunsmith recipes and 5 exclusive Nameless God's Barter recipes; nine regional designs for each family, with no previous weapon consumed.

Six existing Nameless guns, including the sniper, are sold only by The Nameless God's Barter through DarkCoinShop_Weapons Tier 2; neither Gunsmith nor Devil Merchant sells these guns. Ammunition access is unchanged.
Exactly one exclusive ammunition ID per new weapon; receiver plus ammunition equals the selected native base calculator exactly.
Semi-auto requires a new click. SMGs and full-auto rifles repeat only while primary is held and are bounded by their server cadence.
Distance means accumulated 3D projectile travel; each family has its own shared curve, while role pairs preserve identical multipliers at shared distances.
One ammo payment per trigger discharge. A shotgun's six projectile damages partition one shell budget; Eternal Shot refunds once per shell, not per pellet.
Loaded ammunition belongs to each ItemStack; manual native R/Ability4 reload commits matching ammunition only on completion, with no cancellation or swap duplication.
Automatic fire uses one native damage event per bullet. ShotgunLedger aggregates each shell's contacts per target into one damage/proc event; neither receives an extra ammo damage proc.
A player's compatible native enchantments, metadata, durability and ordinary class/skill integration are retained.
All ten new Legendary specials consume two loaded rounds and share the existing RS_LegendaryAbility twelve-second lock, including the original sniper pair.
Heavy Legendary designs favor body damage and control; Luminia designs sacrifice body damage for precision, mobility and range.
Base DPS does not bound flat per-hit class procs. Automatic weapons and the per-shell shotgun aggregator require installed-proc combat testing; preserve native immunity and no global balance edits.
All original models, pixel textures, icons, reload assets and sources remain reproducible; only energy parts use fullbright.

tiers.name: Wildwood Trailwarden

tiers.name: Gutter Saint, Mercy of the Deepworks
tiers.description: The Gobliterator's broken heart turns within an amber lattice. Deepworks smiths listened to the wreckage and forged its stubborn rhythm into a weapon. Cyan rails flare between battered iron ribs; every discharge is followed by the scrape and sigh of machinery forced to remember its purpose. Mobile close-to-mid-range sidearm with measured follow-up shots.
tiers.role: Mobile close-to-mid-range sidearm with measured follow-up shots.

audio.theme: Dense steel-and-coil rail clap, heavy slug feed and amber capacitor prime.

tradeoffs: Higher body damage and body-shot ammunition efficiency
Wider spread and shorter range than the Luminia counterpart
Heavier aimed movement
Control shot requires charging and a longer firing recovery
tiers.progressionNote: Gobliterator core is guaranteed one per native Gobliterator kill; this is a real Deepworks completion gate.
tiers.glowTheme: Amber coil ribs, small cyan rails and restrained warm light.

ability.name: Absolution Hammer
ability.description: Hold Q for 0.35s to fire one focused shot; eligible NPCs stagger for 0.2s. Freeze immunity and enraged interrupt immunity prevent the stagger. The shot commits two loaded rounds and locks firing for 2.52s. Releasing before the charge completes cancels without spending rounds or starting the special cooldown.

tiers.name: Vesper, the Dawn Unspent
tiers.description: Three fragments of Luminia's fallen seals lie aligned within a pale prism. White-gold channels awake around a violet star, casting the small light once kept above the sanctum doors. Its bearer inherits an unfinished vigil: guide the faithful through the dark, and spend the dawn with care. Mobile close-to-mid-range sidearm with measured follow-up shots.
tiers.role: Mobile close-to-mid-range sidearm with measured follow-up shots.

audio.theme: Focused prism discharge, clean glass alignment and a bright white-gold resonance.

tradeoffs: Lower body damage than the Deepworks counterpart
Better headshot ceiling, narrower spread and longer reach
Lighter aimed movement
Two-round mark sacrifices immediate damage; NPC slow immunity remains respected
tiers.progressionNote: Three seal fragments are guaranteed from the Hollow Warden, Luminian Sentinel, and Seal Herald respectively; requires revisiting those bosses if seals were spent on the gateway.
tiers.glowTheme: White-gold channels, cyan prism faces and restrained violet motes.

audio.theme: Warm oak-and-copper report, solid bolt and brass cartridge clicks.

tradeoffs: Shorter effective reach and lower per-trigger impact than a comparable sniper
Frequent reloads interrupt sustained damage

tiers.name: Dunewatch Sandbreaker
tiers.description: Sand-colored wraps cover a thorium-sealed action. In the Howling Sands, the watch keeps its oath long after its banners disappear beneath the dunes. Six-projectile close-range shell; pellet budget is shared across the spread.
tiers.role: Six-projectile close-range shell; pellet budget is shared across the spread.

audio.theme: Dry thorium crack, a gritty side-bolt and a faint yellow-primer ring.

tradeoffs: Shorter effective reach and lower per-trigger impact than a comparable sniper
Frequent reloads interrupt sustained damage

tiers.name: Frostline Hearthguard
tiers.description: Silver tracery runs through cold-worked cobalt. Whisperfrost wardens kept this pattern beside the hearth, ready when the white fields moved. Six-projectile close-range shell; pellet budget is shared across the spread.
tiers.role: Six-projectile close-range shell; pellet budget is shared across the spread.

audio.theme: Crisp cobalt report with a restrained icy overtone and silver lock.

tradeoffs: Shorter effective reach and lower per-trigger impact than a comparable sniper
Frequent reloads interrupt sustained damage

tiers.name: Mournhollow Bellwether
tiers.description: A Mournhollow reliquary key seats behind a violet chamber. Its inscriptions are names, each left unfinished until the living return. Six-projectile close-range shell; pellet budget is shared across the spread.
tiers.role: Six-projectile close-range shell; pellet budget is shared across the spread.

audio.theme: Deep sepulchral report, hollow reliquary latch and violet charge pulses.

tradeoffs: Shorter effective reach and lower per-trigger impact than a comparable sniper
Frequent reloads interrupt sustained damage
tiers.progressionNote: Reliquary Key drops from current Mournhollow packs/bosses; crafting deliberately consumes a key, not an old weapon. Do not claim it requires a full dungeon clear.

tiers.name: Gatecrasher, the Gobliterator's Wake
tiers.description: The Gobliterator's broken heart turns within an amber lattice. Deepworks smiths listened to the wreckage and forged its stubborn rhythm into a weapon. Cyan rails flare between battered iron ribs; every discharge is followed by the scrape and sigh of machinery forced to remember its purpose. Six-projectile close-range shell; pellet budget is shared across the spread.
tiers.role: Six-projectile close-range shell; pellet budget is shared across the spread.

audio.theme: Dense steel-and-coil rail clap, heavy slug feed and amber capacitor prime.

tradeoffs: Higher body damage and body-shot ammunition efficiency
Wider spread and shorter range than the Luminia counterpart
Heavier aimed movement
Control shot requires charging and a longer firing recovery
tiers.progressionNote: Gobliterator core is guaranteed one per native Gobliterator kill; this is a real Deepworks completion gate.
tiers.glowTheme: Amber coil ribs, small cyan rails and restrained warm light.

ability.name: Breach Bell
ability.note: Special replaces the entire six-pellet shell with one focused slug; listed special damage is its TOTAL.
ability.description: Hold Q for 1.2s to fire one focused shot; eligible NPCs stagger for 0.75s. Freeze immunity and enraged interrupt immunity prevent the stagger. The shot commits two loaded rounds and locks firing for 5.6s. Releasing before the charge completes cancels without spending rounds or starting the special cooldown. This special replaces the six-pellet fan with one focused slug; its listed damage is the whole shot.

tiers.name: Solstice, Seven Lamps of Luminia
tiers.description: Three fragments of Luminia's fallen seals lie aligned within a pale prism. White-gold channels awake around a violet star, casting the small light once kept above the sanctum doors. Its bearer inherits an unfinished vigil: guide the faithful through the dark, and spend the dawn with care. Six-projectile close-range shell; pellet budget is shared across the spread.
tiers.role: Six-projectile close-range shell; pellet budget is shared across the spread.

audio.theme: Focused prism discharge, clean glass alignment and a bright white-gold resonance.

tradeoffs: Lower body damage than the Deepworks counterpart
Better headshot ceiling, narrower spread and longer reach
Lighter aimed movement
Two-round mark sacrifices immediate damage; NPC slow immunity remains respected
tiers.progressionNote: Three seal fragments are guaranteed from the Hollow Warden, Luminian Sentinel, and Seal Herald respectively; requires revisiting those bosses if seals were spent on the gateway.
tiers.glowTheme: White-gold channels, cyan prism faces and restrained violet motes.

ability.name: Solstice Beacon
ability.note: Special replaces the entire six-pellet shell with one focused slug; listed special damage is its TOTAL.
ability.description: Press Q for a low-damage setup shot that visibly marks NPCs for 3s and slows eligible NPCs by 40% for 1.25s. Slow-immune NPCs retain only the visual mark. The shot commits two loaded rounds and locks firing for 3s. This special replaces the six-pellet fan with one focused slug; its listed damage is the whole shot.

tiers.name: Hellmaw, Devourer of Souls
tiers.description: Dark silver and a silver skull frame the Nameless God's compact covenant. A red oath-mark hides beneath each violet-lit plate; no maker's name survives. Six-projectile close-range shell; pellet budget is shared across the spread. Sold exclusively through The Nameless God's Barter: Weapons, Tier 2.
tiers.role: Six-projectile close-range shell; pellet budget is shared across the spread.

audio.theme: Dark-silver thump, hollow cage latch and a tense violet fifth.

tradeoffs: Shorter effective reach and lower per-trigger impact than a comparable sniper
Frequent reloads interrupt sustained damage
tiers.progressionNote: Independent recipes consume materials/currency and never an existing enchanted rifle.

tiers.name: Labyrinth Doorwarden
tiers.description: Fullmetal ribs bind a cyan focus in a measured lattice. Labyrinth artificers left one thread unclosed, an invitation to find the next way through. Six-projectile close-range shell; pellet budget is shared across the spread.
tiers.role: Six-projectile close-range shell; pellet budget is shared across the spread.

audio.theme: Machined sabot snap, chrome breech and a short cyan induction zip.

tradeoffs: Shorter effective reach and lower per-trigger impact than a comparable sniper
Frequent reloads interrupt sustained damage
tiers.progressionNote: Fullmetal ore also has an Arcanist bench recipe. This is a regional material theme, not proof of a Labyrinth clear.

tiers.name: Skybound Cloudburst
tiers.description: Windworn brass guards sky-blue steel and a green sight-stone. The Airshop's couriers prefer a light pack and one promise kept above the clouds. Six-projectile close-range shell; pellet budget is shared across the spread.
tiers.role: Six-projectile close-range shell; pellet budget is shared across the spread.

audio.theme: Light carved-wood bark, blue-steel bolt and a clear green-relic chime.

tradeoffs: Shorter effective reach and lower per-trigger impact than a comparable sniper
Frequent reloads interrupt sustained damage
tiers.progressionNote: The Tombstone requires Zelda's Lullaby activation. The independent recipe consumes no previous weapon; its extra flower offsets repeatable crafting versus limited vendor stock.
